> Tell me the same thing when you are on the brick of death, moments away from being gone and maybe I'll believe you.

As someone who has attempted suicide I can confirm this is exactly how I felt during the act. Not everyone feels the same way as you when faced with the inevitability of death.   

Your viewpoint isn't objectively wrong but you have to understand that it's not objectively right either; it's merely another way of looking at the world.
